name: Prowlers of the Barrens
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Now it's time to go after something that really bites.  The prowlers of the Barrens are a tough breed.  Tough, resourceful, sly... and deadly.  You'll find them among the tall grasses.  You'll find many to the southwest of the Crossroads.

Be wary as you hunt them, adventurer, or you may find yourself no longer the predator, but instead the prey.
narrative.objectives: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers. Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
narrative.requestItemsText: How goes your hunt, adventurer? Have you found the prowlers?

chain.subtitle: 13 quests from level 10 to 27, 15,375 XP in all.

quests.name: The Hunter's Way
quests.objectiveText: Bring 4 Flatland Prowler Claws to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

quests.name: Sergra Darkthorn
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Plainstrider Menace
quests.objectiveText: Collect 7 Plainstrider Beaks and return them to Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Zhevra
quests.objectiveText: Slay Zhevra Runners to collect 4 Zhevra Hooves for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Prowlers of the Barrens
quests.objectiveText: Collect 7 Prowler Claws from Savannah Prowlers for Sergra Darkthorn in the Crossroads.

quests.name: Echeyakee
quests.objectiveText: Bring Echeyakee's Hide to Sergra Darkthorn at the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Angry Scytheclaws
quests.objectiveText: Kill Sunscale raptors and collect their feathers.

quests.name: Jorn Skyseer
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Ishamuhale
quests.objectiveText: Bring Ishamuhale's Fang to Jorn at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Enraged Thunder Lizards
quests.objectiveText: Bring 3 Thunder Lizard Blood to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Cry of the Thunderhawk
quests.objectiveText: Find and slay a Thunderhawk, return its wings to Jorn Skyseer at Camp Taurajo.

quests.name: Isha Awak
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Heart of Isha Awak to Mahren Skyseer.
